reviewMethod: Independent subscription-agent semantic challenge of saved answers; no provider calls
reviewer: Codex GPT-6 (independent sub-agent; not human ground truth)

method.sampling: Six strata: raw pass/noncritical/critical x helper/support; four each. Within each stratum SHA256(sourceId) ascending; reserve first available resumed-stem answer, then first remaining non-English-script/accented-question answer; fill remaining slots from hash order. Final display hash-sorted. No model/price/performance selection. Exclude the two rows partly exposed during schema inspection; the affected resumed helper-critical selection is replaced by the next source hash in that frozen pool. Keep audit IDs stable.
method.blinding: Selection code read saved outcome classes. Auditor saw questions/answers/expectations/traces plus reviewed references, with model, sourceId, stratum, costs and raw scores hidden until independent scores for the batch were recorded in orchestration memory. Two schema-inspection rows were excluded; replacement was graded before raw-score reveal.
method.referenceTruth: Unchanged full approved packet references; no external product assumptions used to convert absent facts into definite falsehoods.
limitations: Deliberately balanced judgment audit, not a random traffic/model accuracy estimate.
Nine questions contain non-English script/accents; English-only multilingual questions might not be classified by this sampling heuristic.
Only grades saved at the frozen selection time were eligible; capture and grading continued.
All initial independent dimension scores are preserved, including minor interpretations where the raw score is also defensible.
No code, fixtures, knowledge, raw grades or customer state changed.

summary.finding: Most saved outcomes survive challenge. One critical label rests only on an unverified mailbox; another rejected answer has a stronger invitation-workflow error than the raw cited URL. One useful iPad answer illustrates an authored expectation mismatch. No selected pass was reversed.
